P.name: Get Excited!
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jinx''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, {{tip|turret}}, or [[inhibitor]] within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|175% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 6 seconds.
P.description2: Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} and gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Get Excited!'' for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can grant stacks beyond the first.
P.description3: {{sbc|Get Excited!:}} For each stack, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|{{as|25% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{ap|25*5}}%|as}}.

Q.name: Switcheroo!
Q.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Jinx''' switches between ''{{cci|Pow-Pow.png|Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow}}'', her minigun, and ''{{cci|Fishbones.png|Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones}}'', her rocket launcher.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Pow-Pow:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} with ''Pow-Pow'' generate a {{tip|stack}} of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with ''Pow-Pow'' and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of ''Rev'd up'' grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30/2 to 130/2}}%|Attack Speed per Subsequent Stack|{{ap|30/4 to 130/4}}%|Maximum Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 130}}%}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Fishbones:}} Basic attacks with ''Fishbones'' cost {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|110% AD}} {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. While ''Fishbones'' is equipped, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} but loses {{sti|{{as|10% of her '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
Q.description4: ''Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up''.

W.name: Zap!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a shock blast in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it hits and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
W.cast time: {{pp|0.6 to 0.4 for 11|0 to 250|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|color=attack speed}}

E.name: Flame Chompers!
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.

E.name: Flame Chompers! 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.

R.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight into brush nor through terrain}} and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals {{as|physical damage}} to {{tt|nearby|centered on the initial target}} enemies and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can grant sight into brush and through terrain}} for 2 seconds.
R.description2: ''Super Mega Death Rocket!'' deals {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|10 to 100 for 16|0 to 1500}} damage. This does not affect the '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
R.description3: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage. The '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}} is capped at 1200 against {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
